primary.proposition: mean(RV24 | HIGH funding pressure) - mean(RV24 | LOW funding pressure) > 0

interpretation: The frozen positive-direction proposition was not supported. Within the exact frozen sample and specification, HIGH funding-pressure states did not have greater mean future RV24 than LOW states. The observed HIGH-minus-LOW contrast was negative.
limitations: The preregistration contains no significance threshold.
The preregistration contains no confidence-interval threshold.
The preregistration contains no economic effect-size hurdle.
The preregistration contains no incremental forecasting benchmark.
The preregistration contains no HAR-RV or lagged-RV comparison.
This is a directional falsification / negative Jigsaw observation for this exact proposition, not a general theorem about funding and volatility.

follow_up.question: Does funding pressure provide incremental or stable forecasting information for future volatility beyond lagged realized volatility / HAR-RV-type benchmarks?
